Does anyone else think the more recent airports and Chef's Challenges are scaled too difficult? — Compared to early game, these more recent airports feel like mountains compared to the hills of earlier airports (like Paris, London, Sydney, etc). I can play airports like Singapore, Mumbai, and New York in my sleep in comparison to Shanghai, Berlin, LA, Jakarta, etc. 

At least with the regular airport levels, you can keep trying and you don't lose progress.

The Chef's Challenges for other newer airports, like Berlin, Shanghai, Sapporo, etc. are crazy hard. 

And I thought Mumbai and Mumbai's CC were hard a couple years ago when I played it. 

I barely beat Berlin last week. Only by the skin of my teeth. And I had to use up a TON of my built up reserve of gasoline I've earned from watching ads and calendar rewards. Plus building a strategy. But, really, should I really be putting that much work into beating a single level?

CC's just don't feel fun anymore. It feels like a struggle with the only positive being if you get the 50 gems. But I think I'd earn the 50 gems now if I just replay other airport levels to earn 100+ smiles per game to get gems. I'd spend less gas. And if they expect you to buy an autocooker to somehow beat a CC, then what is the point of that? You just break even buying a 50 gem autocooker to earn 50 gems. 

It's not unlike the frustration of "earning" gas from Daily Tasks, but the tasks ask you to use most if not all of the gas you'd earn to complete the task. So you might only earn 10 gas after completion. 

I must have used up 2500 gas on trying to beat Sapporo's CC 24 levels and still failed to win. That's almost a month of watching ads for someone who doesn't spend real money. It's going to take a lot of time to rebuild that stock of gas. 

Sapporo Levels 22, 23, and 24 were incredibly difficult. And I have 100% on the upgrades for all airports (without spending any real world money ever). And it isn't like I suck as a player. But it still required building up strategies to beat Berlin and Sapporo to cut time and increase speed. As well as repeated play to gain experience. It worked for Berlin, but not for Sapporo. 

It's like the devs/game have made it so all new airports are intended to push you to spend money. To buy unlimited gasoline, gems, autocookers, and everything. But even then, the CCs are very unforgiving. So it forces you to keep trying over and over within the 2day limitation. 

But, honestly, it just isn't fun. It just feels punishing. After all the effort I put into Sapporo and still lost, it makes me less inclined to play CCs. Which used to be fun. I looked forward to them. After playing 3-4 of the more recent airports... that excitement has cooled. I don't mind a challenge. But the scaling just feels way too hard. And the limitations for earning gems and gasoline is frustration. 

I'm not asking for an easy mode. I don't mind difficulties. But the scaling feels too steep. And it is getting tiring that they are ALL hard now. The CCs seem specially designed to be so hard it forces you to spend real money, but even that is not a certainty for success, imo. So it means replaying CCs over and over, namely for unlimited gas, thus spending more money. That feels like what the thought behind their design now. Like they see an increase of revenue making them this hard, thus keep increasing the difficulty. Thus skewing this game more and more into a money sink at a rigged carnival you might get lucky at. 

I feel bad for people starting out in AC, thinking the early stage levels are hard. And they have yet to set foot into late stage airports like Shanghai or Jakarta. Especially anyone who is like me, doing the hard/long grind as a free player. If you don't want to or can't spend money and you just want to play a fun cooking game without stress.

Even Cooking Fever feels more balanced as far as difficulty and the grind it takes to earn gems/coins there for people who don't spend money. New restaurants are fun. Challenges don't feel insurmountable and require hundreds of replays to beat. Plus you don't have a limited amount of gas to play. 

I'm not trying to complain, but this is affecting my enjoyment of AC. It made me wonder if anyone else felt similarly?
Finally.. — This was the single worst airport I’ve had to 3 star, bar none. Took so many upgrades. Genuine stress as I played it
